name: Michael Amini Windsor Court Fruitwood Traditional Round Table Dining Set By Aico
description: The Windsor Court collection is part of "Michael Amini Original Furniture Designs". The refined casual comfort and cultural traditions of the English countryside, with its quaint villages and peaceful vistas, are beautifully expressed in this superb collection. Sumptuous top-grain leather and plush fabrics, antiqued brass nail head details, and hand-carved wood trim accents distinguish the Windsor Court Collection. Reversible leather and fabric cushions allow for versatility, and fashion. Comfort accompanies charm with feather blend cushions and 100% feather pillows. The subtle textures, gentle curves, and warm tones of the Vintage Fruitwood finish inspire a sense of elegance, and echoes of the past. With the scale and proportion to suit any home, each carefully crafted piece evokes a stately ambience. Combining classy designs with consummate craftsmanship, the Windsor Court Round Dining Table Set in Vintage Fruitwood will definitely bring beauty and grace into your dining area. It exhibits understated details and possesses unbeatable appeal. Add charm to your home with a dash of elegance with this set. Like the famous Windsor Court in England, the Amini Windsor Court Fabric Back Dining Side Chair welcomes visitors and royalty alike. This dining room side chair is perfectly proportioned to suit any home and is crafted of birch solids with exotic wood veneers finished in vintage fruitwood. The hand carved scrollwork results in a side chair that would be at home in the well-appointed country homes of English nobility. The seat and back are upholstered in soft, earth-toned fabric that evokes stately ambiance. Dinner is served with style and grace. The Windsor Court Fabric Back Dining Arm Chair is a luxurious way to appoint your dining room. This dining room chair is crafted of birch solids with exotic wood veneers completed with a warm, rich vintage fruitwood finish.
